# Attribution

These images are downscaled derivatives (longest side 320 px, boxes rescaled) of the following dataset, used only as a small test fixture.

- Source: Aalto L-PBF powder bed and optical tomography images
- DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.14996805
- License: CC-BY-4.0
- Content: per build, the first 20 labeled powder bed (PB) and 20 labeled optical tomography (OT) images (3 builds)
- Regenerate with `uv run layerwise make-fixture`.
